summary: The change adds the control-plane workspace update API (status, upgrade, host report and registry token), maintenance admission in the workspace server, and the config and IAM wiring. F5 is resolved: a report clears consent only when the state first becomes `failed`, or when it is `upgrading` or the target version. A durable test shows that a retry after a failure still reaches the host, with `activate: true` and a `requestId`. F6 is resolved because the unused update block was removed from the development config reader. Both test tiers pass, every changed line is covered or has an exemption I accept, and no findings remain.
